subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word given in brackets to fill in the blank.

The student provided her English teacher a short and _________(incoherent) account of her journey to Shimla with her parents.
solution:
The correct answer is: **lucid.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"incoherent"** means something that is unclear, confusing, or not logically connected. (अस्पष्ट)

 
 
• **Example: **His speech was incoherent, making it hard for anyone to understand his point.
 
 
 
• **"Lucid"** refers to something that is clear and easy to understand; it is logically connected and well-organized. (स्पष्ट)
 
 
• **Example: **The professor provided a lucid explanation of the complex theory, making it easy for students to grasp.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'incoherent'** is **'lucid'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2 i.e. lucid**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Humble** (विनम्र): Having or showing a modest or low estimate of one's importance.

 
 
• **Example:** Despite his success, he remained humble and approachable.
 
 
 
• **Rough** (खुरदरा): Having an uneven or irregular surface; not smooth.
 
 
• **Example:** The rough texture of the wall made it difficult to paint.
 
 
 
• **Genuine** (असली): Truly what something is said to be; authentic.
 
 
• **Example:** She wore a genuine smile that brightened up the room.
